about.title: About
about.lead: I create illustrations and concept art for game projects — from the first sketch to the final render.
about.body: I focus on clear technical requirements and visual consistency across every production stage. I respond quickly to feedback and work closely with teams to turn ideas into polished, coherent worlds.
